claims: The actual pinned public CPU backend returned the level0 red plane for all six synthetic unredirected fixedLOD0/1/2 cases in UV and ST modes; four TEX0 redirection controls returned the authored green and blue planes. Each draw checked four CPU VRAM pixels.

With the visually reviewed Sony GS manual's LCM1 fixedLOD=K, MXL2, MMIN2 point nearest mip mode and explicit MIPTBP bases, the synthetic unredirected integerLOD1/2 cases specify levels1/2. Actual CPU output disagreed with that specified selection in four cases. This is a manual reference comparison, not a hardware observation.

The sample used only authored color planes and synthetic draw state; source and binary preflight exclude 4746 generated original guest functions and display/audio entry symbols. It does not establish actual draw-time mip selection or visible texture corruption in the original game.
